props.text: Top-quality equipment to keep your business moving.

At Sun State International, our mission is to provide top-quality equipment to keep your business moving. We understand that efficiency and reliability are critical in warehouse and distribution operations, which is why we are proud to offer Capacity yard trucks.

Designed for strength, durability, and maximum performance, Capacity yard trucks help streamline your operations and keep your business running smoothly. Learn more about our available models and find the perfect fit for your operation.

props.eyebrow: WHY YOU NEED A CAPACITY YARD TRUCK

props.text: Capacity yard trucks provide the strength and dependability your business needs to operate efficiently every day. Whether you need a single-axle model for light-duty operations or a heavy-duty tandem-axle unit for the toughest jobs, there is a Capacity yard truck designed for your specific needs.
These powerful yard trucks are the backbone of modern logistics, ensuring seamless transportation of trailers within busy work environments.

image.alt: A Capacity yard truck in a distribution yard

values.heading: Shop from the brand that started it all.
values.body: Capacity introduced the "Original Trailer Jockey" almost fifty years ago. Now, it has evolved into three powerful models tailored for various operational needs. The TJ Series includes the TJ5000, TJ6500, and TJ9000, each designed with unique features and capabilities. Whether you need a single or double rear axle, off-road, or DOT-certified model, these yard trucks provide unmatched versatility and performance.

items.title: TJ5000
items.body: The TJ5000 is a single-axle yard jockey truck designed for strength and efficiency. For in-house use there is an off-highway model perfect for warehouse and distribution operations, where durability and maneuverability are essential. It also comes in a DOT model, better suited for intermodal trucking and operations that require navigating rough surface conditions like potholes and railroad crossings.
items.specs: GCWR Up to 81,000 lbs Can move Up to 242,000 lbs Models Off-highway & DOT

items.title: TJ6500
items.body: The TJ6500 is a tandem-axle yard jockey truck built for increased stability and load capacity. This model is built to handle demanding applications and is ideal for warehouse work, especially in environments with rough surface conditions. For businesses that require over-the-road operations, we offer tandem-axle non-DOT models with on-road and off-road capabilities.
items.specs: GCWR Up to 125,000 lbs Gradability 90,000 lbs Best for Rough surfaces

items.title: TJ9000
items.body: The TJ9000 is a powerful single-axle yard jockey truck, designed for the toughest jobs. It offers unmatched strength and flexibility for a variety of industries, and can be used across intermodal, warehouse and distribution, and port trucking applications, adapting to different operational needs and rough surface conditions.

items.q: What is a yard truck used for?
items.a: Yard trucks, also called trailer jockeys or spotters, move trailers within a facility. They are the backbone of modern logistics in distribution centers, warehouses, ports, rail car terminals and intermodal trucking operations.

items.q: Which Capacity TJ model should I choose?
items.a: The TJ5000 is a single-axle truck with a GCWR up to 81,000 lbs that can move up to 242,000 pounds, in off-highway or DOT versions. The TJ6500 is a tandem-axle model with a GCWR up to 125,000 pounds and 90,000 pounds of gradability for greater stability. The TJ9000 is a single-axle model with a GCWR up to 242,000 pounds for the toughest intermodal, warehouse and port applications.

items.q: What is the difference between off-highway and DOT models?
items.a: Off-highway models are intended for in-house use in warehouse and distribution operations where durability and maneuverability matter most. DOT models are better suited to intermodal trucking and operations that require navigating rough surface conditions like potholes and railroad crossings.

Dura-Ride is a suspension option offering enhanced comfort for operators, less wear and tear on cargo, reduced maintenance costs and improved operator health and safety. Ask us about Dura-Ride options for the TJ5000 and TJ9000.

items.q: Can I finance a Capacity yard truck?
items.a: Yes. With approved credit and a minimal down payment you can secure financing, and combine physical damage insurance, GAP waivers, extended service contracts and protection plans into one convenient monthly payment.

items.q: Do you stock Capacity parts and service yard trucks?
items.a: Yes. Our aftermarket parts department stocks Capacity yard tractor parts and handles warranty, and our service departments in Tampa, Sarasota and Davenport service yard trucks, with mobile service available at your yard.

values.heading: Tell us about your yard.
values.body: Trailer weights, surface conditions, shifts per day and whether you need DOT certification — that's all we need to point you at the right TJ model.
